description: The magic key is a configured character (hotstrings.trigger_char), never a physical key position (maintainer's decision of 2026-11-21). Hotstring data always writes the real marker; each driver replaces it by the configured character at runtime. Its default is the manifest default of hotstrings.trigger_char, unless the layout that types belongs to one of the families below: their base levels are probed on the listed keys (W3C KeyboardEvent.code), and a family matches when every key it names types that character with no modifier. Every user-facing text shows the marker followed by the configured character in parentheses (display_format) whenever that character is not the marker itself; the locale keys in literal_marker_keys name the real ★ character (the CapsWord delimiter, the option offering ★, the key that types ★), so their ★ stays as written. Lua: _shared/hotstrings/engine/magic_key.lua; AutoHotkey: _shared/hotstrings/data/magic_key.ahk; JavaScript: _shared/ui/hotstring_editor/script.js. All three replay _shared/tests/corpus/hotstrings/magic_key_vectors.json.
